# SDF Clothing — AI Knowledge File (Full Reference)

> This file previously extended llms.txt with page-level content from SDF Clothing's Insights guides library. That guides section was retired on 2026-08-22 as part of a site-wide cleanup down to the company's core, always-current pages. For all company facts, certifications, pricing, process, and trade knowledge, see https://sdfltd.com/llms.txt — it remains the single authoritative AI-reference file.

> SDF Clothing is a full-package low MOQ clothing manufacturer for startup and boutique fashion brands. Founded: August 22, 1998 | Founder: Chowdhury Remon | Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh | MOQ: 300 pieces per style | Certifications: 13 international | Years operating: 27+ | All sales and support handled directly from the Dhaka head office (former representative offices in the UK, USA, Australia, South Africa, and Italy closed post-COVID).
